description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the SearchByPic operation for online calls to the Taobao Alliance Edition
description_zh: 本文为您介绍SearchByPic接口的语法及示例，用于向淘宝联盟版在线调用
name: SearchByPic

parameters.help_en:
The image content.
The image size cannot exceed 4 MB.
Image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP, TIFF, and PPM.
The transmission wait time cannot exceed 5 seconds.
The image cannot contain rotation information.
If you use an SDK, you do not need to set the PicContent field. The SDK encapsulates this field as the PicContentObject field
parameters.help_zh:
图片内容。
图片大小要求不超过4 MB。
图片格式：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、WEBP、TIFF、PPM。
传输等待时间不超过5秒。
图片中不能包含旋转信息。
如使用SDK，则无需填写PicContent字段，SDK已将本字段封装为PicContentObject字段无需处理
parameters.name: pic_content

parameters.help_en:
The image category. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html.
If you specify a category, the specified category is used. If you do not specify a category, the system predicts the category. You can obtain the predicted category result from the response
parameters.help_zh:
图片类目。具体请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html。
如果设置类目，则以设置的为准；如果不设置类目，则由系统进行类目预测，预测的类目结果可以在Response中获取
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The PID. For more information, see PID (https://mos.m.taobao.com/union/pub/site/help?spm=a219t.11817172.PortalLayout.d52e56935.27ac6a15wlAEHe).
This field is available when you use SDK V1.1.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
PID。具体请参考PID (https://mos.m.taobao.com/union/pub/site/help?spm=a219t.11817172.PortalLayout.d52e56935.27ac6a15wlAEHe)。
使用V1.1.0及以上版本的SDK可用该字段
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform subject identification. Default value: true.
If this parameter is set to true, the system performs subject identification. We recommend that you use this method.
If this parameter is set to false, subject identification is not performed, and the entire image is used for the search
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要进行主体识别。默认true。
为true时，由系统进行主体识别。建议使用此方式。
为false时，则不进行主体识别，以整张图进行搜索
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en:
The subject region of the image, in the format of `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` is the upper-left point and `x2,y2` is the lower-right point.
If you specify Region, the system uses the specified Region for the search regardless of the value of the Crop parameter
parameters.help_zh:
图片的主体区域，格式为`x1,x2,y1,y2`, 其中`x1,y1 `是左上角的点，`x2,y2`是右下角的点。
若用户设置了Region，则不论Crop参数为何值，都将以用户输入Region进行搜索
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The start position of the returned results. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of returned results. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。取值范围：1~20。默认值为10
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The list of fields to return. Separate multiple fields with commas. The PicUrl, ReservePrice, Title, Url, and ZkFinalPrice fields are always returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 需要返回的字段list。不同的字段用逗号分割。默认PicUrl,ReservePrice,Title,Url,ZkFinalPrice字段必返回
parameters.name: fields

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. This parameter is used to distinguish channels in Taobao Alliance
parameters.help_zh: 渠道ID。用于淘宝联盟中的渠道区分
parameters.name: relation_id

Code.description_en:
The error code.

0: success.

Non-zero: failure
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

0：成功，

非0：失败

RankScore.description_en: The ranking score of product similarity. Valid values: 0 to 1
RankScore.description_zh: 商品相似性的排名分数。取值范围：0~1

CategoryName.description_zh: 商品信息-一级类目名称

CommissionRate.description_en: The commission rate. For example, 1550 indicates 15.5%
CommissionRate.description_zh:
商品信息-佣金比率。
如：1550表示15.5%

CouponAmount.description_en: The coupon amount in CNY. If the product is a pre-sale product, the coupon can be used for the final payment but not for the deposit
CouponAmount.description_zh: 优惠券（元）若属于预售商品，该优惠券付尾款可用，付定金不可用

CouponEndTime.description_en: The end time of the coupon
CouponEndTime.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券结束时间

CouponInfo.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券满减信息

CouponRemainCount.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券剩余量

CouponShareUrl.description_en: The combined product and coupon page URL
CouponShareUrl.description_zh: 链接-宝贝+券二合一页面链接

CouponStartFee.description_en: The minimum spend threshold for the coupon. For example, a coupon that provides a CNY 20 discount on purchases of CNY 299 or more
CouponStartFee.description_zh:
优惠券信息-优惠券启用门槛，满X元可用。
如：满299元减20元

CouponStartTime.description_en: The start time of the coupon
CouponStartTime.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券开始时间

CouponTotalCount.description_zh: 优惠券信息-优惠券总量

DeeplinkCouponShareUrl.description_en: The deep link for launching the Taobao app with the coupon

DeeplinkUrl.description_en: The deep link for product promotion
DeeplinkUrl.description_zh: 链接-宝贝推广的深度唤醒链接

LevelOneCategoryName.description_zh: 商品信息-叶子类目名称

MaxCommissionClickUrl.description_en: The product promotion URL with the highest commission rate
MaxCommissionClickUrl.description_zh: 商品信息-链接-最优佣金率宝贝推广链接

MaxCommissionCouponShareUrl.description_en: The combined product and coupon page URL with the highest commission rate
MaxCommissionCouponShareUrl.description_zh: 商品信息-链接-最优佣金率宝贝+券二合一页面链接

MaxCommissionRate.description_en: The highest commission rate. For example, 20.4 indicates a commission rate of 20.4%
MaxCommissionRate.description_zh:
商品信息-最优佣金率。
如：20.4表示佣金率为20.4%

PriceAfterCoupon.description_en: The price after the coupon is applied

ReservePrice.description_en: The fixed price, which is usually displayed as the original price with a strikethrough
ReservePrice.description_zh: 商品信息-一口价通常显示为划线价

ShortTitle.description_en: The short product title. We recommend that you use this title on mobile devices
ShortTitle.description_zh: 商品信息-商品短标题（移动端建议使用）

UserType.description_zh:
店铺信息-卖家类型。

1：天猫，

0：淘宝

Volume.description_en: The sales volume in the last 30 days

ZkFinalPrice.description_en: The online selling price in CNY. If the product is a pre-sale product, the online selling price equals the pre-sale price during the deposit payment period
ZkFinalPrice.description_zh: 商品信息-在线售价(元)。若属于预售商品，付定金时间内，在线售卖价=预售价格

PicInfo.description_en: The information such as category prediction and subject identification results
PicInfo.description_zh: 类目预测、主体识别结果等信息

MainRegion.description_en: The multi-category information of the subject

MultiCategoryId.description_en: The collection of category prediction results for the subject prediction region
MultiCategoryId.description_zh: 主体预测区域的类目预测结果集合

items.description_en: The category prediction result for the subject prediction region
items.description_zh: 主体预测区域的类目预测结果

CategoryId.description_en: The image category. For more information, see [Category reference]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html）
CategoryId.description_zh: 图片类目。具体请参考[类目参考]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html）

Score.description_en: The predicted category score. Valid values: 0 to 1
Score.description_zh: 预测的类目得分。取值范围：0~1

Region.description_en: The subject identification result. The subject region of the image, in the format of x1,x2,y1,y2, where x1,y1 is the upper-left point and x2,y2 is the lower-right point. If you specify the subject region in the request, the specified region is used
Region.description_zh: 主体识别结果。图片的主体区域，格式为x1,x2,y1,y2，其中 x1,y1 是左上角的点，x2，y2是右下角的点。若用户请求中指定了主体区域，则以请求中为准

MultiRegion.description_en: The collection of subject identification results

Region.description_en: The subject identification result. The subject region of the image, in the format of x1,x2,y1,y2, where x1,y1 is the upper-left point and x2,y2 is the lower-right point. If you specify the subject region in the request, the specified region is used
Region.description_zh: 主体识别结果。图片的主体区域，格式为x1,x2,y1,y2，其中 x1,y1 是左上角的点，x2，y2是右下角的点。若用户请求中指定了主体区域，则以请求中为准

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
